desc: the touch Spin Dash button plays as the Spin Dash binding (a ROM linked, the setting on; a faked 16:9 phone sideways): with the stick held right Mario runs, a tap on the swirl spins him that way (toward 90) and, the stick still held through the spin's end, hands him straight back into the run; tapped again and again while he runs, the spins chain (a tap mid-spin does what the binding's does: nothing until it ends); then the stick let go and a tap spins him in place, facing as he was ($TTYD_TOUCH_EDIT_DO tap=16, Aurora built with TTYD_TOUCH_OVERLAY=ON)
